title: Terminal and Echo
author: Emrys Crane
blurb: Mara Pemberton, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
